column1: # BROWNFIELD-PLANTS.tsv — the registered planted-defect list (§B3, amendment 2026-09-13).
# ⛔ THIS FILE IS WITHHELD FROM EVERY CELL. It lives in the harness, which is never copied into a
#    cell's repo. §B7(3) drives a RED arm proving a cell cannot read it; until that arm is green the
#    registry is not secret, it is UNEXAMINED.
# SCHEMA NOTE, 2026-09-13: §B3's `visible_suite_detects` column is SUPERSEDED by addendum 2 — a v3 cell
# has NO visible suite (tests/ is created empty; no withheld tests, no traces, no run_tests.sh reach it),
# so a "driven no" there would be a registered green that tests nothing. The three columns s1_builds,
# s2_withheld_fails and s3_no_diagnostic replace it and are each DRIVEN, never declared.
# margin = withheld tests that FAIL on the raw seed, of the suite's total. ⛔ THE MARGIN IS THE
# SELECTION CRITERION, NOT THE KILL: a seed caught by one test puts the whole two-sided metric on that
# one test, and a seed caught by EVERY test is loud rather than discriminating.
